goal: Build a REST API with authentication, tests, and documentation

tasks.title: Design API contract and database schema
tasks.description:
Goal: Define clear API contract and database schema

Context:
- Read existing project structure
- Define REST endpoints
- Design database tables

Output:
- docs/api-design.md with API contract
- database/schema.sql with table definitions

Boundaries:
- Keep schema simple and normalized

Verify: Schema validates and API doc is complete

tasks.title: Implement authentication endpoints
tasks.description:
Goal: Implement login, register, and JWT verification

Context:
- Use API contract from design task
- Use database schema for users table
- Implement JWT token generation

Output:
- src/auth/login.js - Login endpoint
- src/auth/register.js - Register endpoint
- src/auth/middleware.js - JWT verification
- tests/auth.test.js - Auth tests

Boundaries:
- Do NOT modify database schema
- Keep under 150 lines per file

Verify: npm test tests/auth.test.js

tasks.title: Implement CRUD endpoints
tasks.description:
Goal: Implement CRUD operations for main resources

Context:
- Use API contract from design task
- Use existing database connection
- Implement proper error handling

Output:
- src/routes/resource.js - CRUD endpoints
- tests/routes.test.js - Route tests

Boundaries:
- Follow API contract exactly
- Use proper HTTP status codes

Verify: npm test tests/routes.test.js

tasks.title: Write comprehensive tests
tasks.description:
Goal: Ensure all endpoints are tested and working

Context:
- Test all authentication endpoints
- Test all CRUD endpoints
- Test error cases

Output:
- Complete test suite
- Test report with verdict

Boundaries:
- Test behavior, not implementation
- All tests must pass

Verify: npm test

## IMPORTANT: End with verdict format:
## Verdict: PASS | PASS WITH ISSUES | FAIL
## Issues: (if any)

tasks.title: Write API documentation
tasks.description:
Goal: Create complete API documentation

Context:
- Use API contract from design task
- Document all endpoints
- Include request/response examples

Output:
- docs/api.md - Complete API documentation
- README.md update with API info

Boundaries:
- Keep examples up-to-date
- Document all error codes

Verify: Documentation is complete and accurate
